hypothesis: With the same EfficientNet-B1, BCE loss, batch size and optimizer-step budget as a random-sampling control, deterministic mini-batch quotas over VFT label tail, even-cardinality combination tail and VFT weak-visibility rows improve VFT ranking rather than merely amplifying positive responses.

fresh_data.identity_contract: all nine power views of one receiver_noise_seed remain in exactly one role

training_manifest.combination_tail: even-cardinality nonempty combinations target 10 samples each; odd-cardinality combinations absorb remaining mass under exact label constraints
training_manifest.visibility_tail: VFT-positive identities coexisting with any fixed component receive one deterministic 10/15/20 dB view; all other identities use 30 dB

models.C0_random_BCE: efficientnet_b1_1d with ordinary replacement random mini-batches
models.C1_axis_stratified_BCE: same efficientnet_b1_1d weights, same BCE, same fixed-view examples and same update budget; each batch has 16 VFT-positive weak rows, 4 other VFT-positive rows, 16 VFT-negative SinFM+MFT+ISRJ hard-negative rows and 28 remaining rows, sampled with deterministic replacement

selection_and_calibration.checkpoint: highest early-stop macro-AUPR; ties resolve by VFT AUPR then lowest epoch
selection_and_calibration.threshold: per-class F1 grid on calibration role only; one frozen threshold set per model; no development retuning
selection_and_calibration.development: all nine powers, all 2520 held-out identities; paired views cluster by receiver_noise_seed

response_risk: VFT FPR by power and combination
VFT hard-negative FPR for VFT=0 and SinFM=MFT=ISRJ=1
metrics.separation: mean VFT probability on positives minus mean VFT probability on fixed hard negatives

stop_rule: If any development gate fails, stop axis-stratified sampling permanently on these identities. Do not change quotas, steps, loss, thresholds, backbone, target label, tail definition or gates; do not generate confirmation identities. If it passes, freeze code and checkpoints, run the two pre-specified additional model seeds, then require two fresh identity-pool no-retuning confirmations before any locked-test request.
